briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 escalate multi-agent capabilities amid compute crunch

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with o4 and Grok-3 releases driving new benchmarks. Multi-agent systems dominate development priorities while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with 2.1T parameters achieving 94% on MMLU-Pro; xAI launches Grok-3 focused on real-time reasoning; DeepSeek-V4 and Meta's Llama-4 variants push open-source boundaries. Anthropic's Claude 4 enters private beta with enhanced safety layers.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped; Microsoft and Google announce $45B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports record AI chip orders through Q3.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI-level system emerge from a closed lab or an open consortium by 2028?
